test.title: 复古时尚九宫格大片
test.test_input: Portray the fictional adult character Steve Harrington as a 25-year-old man.
test.adaptation: ChatGPT适配测试，非原指定模型实测
changes: 填充虚构人物/年龄；其他要求保留，非原示例人物实测。
test.selected_source_prompt:
Editorial fashion contact sheet (3×3 grid) featuring Steve Harrington, styled in a high-fashion reinterpretation of his iconic look. Voluminous swept-back hair, confident expression, subtle retro 80s attitude. Wearing a navy-and-red sailor-inspired top with a tailored silhouette, minimal accessories, classic wristwatch. Shot in a minimalist studio with a neutral grey backdrop.

Pose sequence across the 3×3 grid:

Front-facing portrait, hand raised toward the camera, palm open

Low-angle three-quarter view, hand reaching forward, strong foreshortening

Top-down full-body shot, arm extended toward the lens

Back view, head slightly turned, hand lifted mid-air

Clean side profile, hand partially entering the frame from foreground

Tilted angle portrait, hand close to lens, playful perspective distortion

Extreme close-up, face partially obscured by hand

Full-body centered shot, arm fully extended toward camera

High-angle shot, head tilted down, hands relaxed

Clean high-fashion editorial styling with subtle retro influence, bold yet controlled color contrast, soft diffused studio lighting, crisp focus, contemporary magazine aesthetic, 35mm–50mm lens look, ultra-sharp, high resolution, cinematic yet polished.
